title: P1 Guideline document store and the writing resolver (Python, no door)
description:
What: the storage and resolution core, usable from Python before any deploy.

Files:
- src/papyrus_content/guidelines/__init__.py, document.py (writing schemaVersion 1: voice, audience, tone, sentenceStyle, voicePatterns, structure, lexicon.prefer/avoid, glossary, headline, exemplars, bodyMarkus, constraints, locked; validation errors by field)
- src/papyrus_content/guidelines/store.py (current version by itemBySlug / itemByTenantSlug; write a new doctrine Item version with catalog fields only plus a doctrine_document ModelAttachment via build_json_model_payload_attachment + upload_attachment_body in src/papyrus_content/model_attachments.py; expected-version check; no-op save makes no version; history)
- src/papyrus_content/guidelines/layering.py, writing.py (resolve publication then section: prose appended, avoid-lists joined, choices replaced unless locked, constraints publication-only; fieldSources and layers {slug, version, contentHash}; warnings writing_guidelines_missing, section_constraint_ignored)
- slugs: editorial-doctrine-writing, desk-doctrine-<sectionKey>-writing, desk-doctrine-<sectionKey>-visual-style (mirror lib/doctrine.ts)
- src/papyrus_content/guidelines/*_test.py; features_backend/guidelines-store.feature, features_backend/guidelines-writing-resolve.feature + steps

Acceptance checks:
- publications/anthus/style-profile.yml and publications/pilobolus/style-profile.yml validate unchanged as writing documents.
- A save writes one Item row with empty bodyMarkus/metadata and one S3 document; reading returns the same document; contentHash matches.
- Every read is an index query or a get (a fake store fails the test on any list/scan).
- poetry run pytest src/papyrus_content/guidelines and behave features_backend/guidelines-*.feature pass.

Gherkin scenarios:
- Saving a writing document stores the text in S3 and only a catalog row in the database
- Saving an unchanged document makes no new version
- Saving against a stale version is refused
- A section adds tone and voice patterns after the site's
- A section cannot remove a word the site avoids
- A section replaces the audience when the site leaves it open
- A section cannot replace a field the site locks
- A section's binding constraint is ignored with a warning
- A site with no writing guidelines resolves with a warning, not an error
- Every resolved field names the layer and version it came from

Design: docs/plans/guidelines-as-data.md. Gherkin specs are required and ship in the same PR. Text lives in S3, never inline in DynamoDB; no new GSI; no subscriptions. Style and voice wording is data, never code.
